notes.title: Major update: v1.2 "Remastered" is now live.
notes.content:
Greetings players and future players,

Since release, we've spent time hanging out with players and watching streamers play. This has been an invaluable source of feedback! One common observation has been that, artistically speaking, the game seems to hark back to some retro era that didn't actually exist: This is a reality about Goldenheart that will never really change and was only somewhat intentional.

However, this update attempts to bring the style of the game together into a more cohesive package by altering the render pipeline at each step of the way:


 The textures have been reduced from 2k to 512, reducing the overall size of the game by about 1GB.

 Unreal Engine's cutting edge downsampling/upsampling pipeline with TSR antialiasing has been replaced with a more traditional pipeline which renders the game at full 3D resolution and applies good old Fast Approximate antialiasing at the end.

 In post process, the pixel resolution is then decreased, and colors are reduced all the way down to 16 before dithering, which creates the illusion of increasing the colors again - very old-school but also somewhat trendy at present.

 The UI has also been overhauled to match the new look, and each game level has been adjusted and tweaked as well.

 A gamma/brightness slider has been added to the graphics settings, allowing us to push the overall contrast and lighting effects per level to a more extreme degree, increasing ambiance and variety.


As the co-creator of the game, let me just say this: This is kind of what I always wanted for the game, but it's taken some research and development to make it happen in a way that we're happy with, so I'm glad we didn't rush it. Unfortunately, these changes run deep, making it impractical to toggle between versions at runtime.

I understand that some or perhaps many players will prefer the previous high-resolution graphics, which is why I've created a new branch called "Legacy" which will continue to host v1.1.2 permanently.
To access the Legacy branch: Select Goldenheart in your steam library, click the gear icon -> properties -> betas -> beta participation: select Legacy from the drop-down. 

Please drop by our Discord and let us know what you think!

Thanks for all your support,
Kippercans
Millenniapede Audio Video Club

notes.title: 1.2 beta patch - release candidate 1 - live on beta branch
notes.content:
I patched the 1.2 beta build on the BETA branch to fix graphical issues I found in testing:

-All small light sources have been checked and fixed for brightness issues, pending further testing.
-The NPC clothing textures and skin tones have been fixed.
-The Boss Health Bar has been updated to the new UI style.
-The "Goldenheart" title image resolution has been fixed.

When testing is finished, the new version (1.2 - remastered) will be moved to the main branch and the original previous version (1.1) will be put onto a permanent Legacy branch, for players who prefer the old aesthetic and UI.

notes.title: v1.1.2 patch - bug fix
notes.content: This small patch attempts to correct an error from the v1.1 update that may have accidentally downgraded the player's collision detection, causing characters to more easily clip through walls when being "launched" by an enemy attack or other force. We'll continue to watch out for cases of this, please continue to report! Thank you :)

notes.title: Patch v1.1.1 - bug fixes
notes.content:
v1.1.1 small patch

 Fixed a bug in the Oasis that could prevent the exit portal from loading in certain scenarios (if you got stuck here you should be able to resume playing as normal)
 Fixed a bug that caused two NPCs to disappear in a certain scenario in the final level
 Fixed a typo on an NPC's nametag in Mt. Tulderon Trail

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
V1.1 notable changes:

 Steam’s Cloud Saves system has been enabled.
 Steam Achievements have been implemented throughout the game.
 The Poetry Books written about the winners of the Launch Contest have been hidden in various places.
 No spoilers but the endgame cutscenes have been completely overhauled.
 Several levels have received minor changes, improvements, and bug fixes.

Difficulty settings changes:

 The difficulty settings (previously experimental) have been finalized down to three settings. If you were playing on one of the “in-between” settings your current setting will be rounded up or down so please check on the pause menu to make sure you are where you want to be.
 Story Mode: 0.5x incoming damage, right in between the old “easier” settings. Monster spawn changes carried from previous “Story Mode.”
 Normal Mode: previously “adventure mode” - no modifier, default spawns.
 Souls Mode: The same as “Master Mode” but without restricting its selection to game slot creation.

Other notable changes and fixes:

 Running out of stamina will no longer prevent you from using the sword, but using the sword will still drain stamina.
 Slow moving projectiles and homing projectiles can now be targeted.
 The Save Slots now show how many out of 16 possible health upgrades have been found.
 The player’s blocking detection for high-velocity projectiles has been improved to avoid an error that can occur when blocking Skeleton Archer arrows near the outer extent of their range.
 A bug that caused Stalagmite damage to the player to be triggered multiple times on a single contact has been fixed (effectively reducing the damage)

notes.title: v1.012 patch - Air control and Melee Overhaul
notes.content:
This update has been in the works for some time but was kept separate from yesterday's patch to help keep us from getting our wires crossed. These changes introduce several new features "under the hood" to help to make the game play more smoothly.

Please let us know if you encounter any bugs!

Air control added to jumping and falling physics:
This makes all of the platforming a bit more forgiving, especially on jumps with odd angles or distances to cover, because you can continue to navigate somewhat while airborne.

Melee overhaul:

 The range of the sword has been increased.
 The accuracy of the sword attacks have been improved to avoid hitting walls etc while aiming at enemies etc.
 You can no longer attack with the sword while your stamina is depleted.
 Sword attacks now consume stamina, the amount depends on which sword you have.
 Dodging now consumes less stamina, in order to compensate for the attack cost.
 Block input can no longer interrupt a sword attack before the hit check begins.
 An input buffer will now re-trigger blocking if the block button is held after stamina regeneration or a committed sword attack has done a hit check.
 Another input buffer will now queue consecutive sword attacks when the input is received before the current sword attack reaches it's hit check, without interrupting the current sword attack.

notes.title: v1.011 patch - bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused your old sword to remain visible when equipping your new sword
 Improved asset loading in Tul Alorea
 Moved a save point in Tul Alorea to decrease backtracking
 Fixed a bug in Tul Enorye that sometimes showed the wrong kind of arrow drop

notes.title: v1.01 patch - small patch
notes.content:
Music now continues playing while the game paused.
 Adjusted the master mix and default audio levels to allow more gain on devices with limited output like steam deck.
 Some monster spawns in the outdoor section of Quardona Caverns have been thinned out somewhat.
 Fixed a minor bug that prevented the weapons from un-equipping on death.
 Cavanarg no longer takes reduced piercing damage (arrows).
 Fixed some exposed backfaces in nooks and crannies of maps.
 A floating tree is now planted safely in the ground.
 A climbing wall in Nyvena has been made a bit more obvious.
 The storage room in Tul Enorye has been subtly color coded to indicate which blocks can be transformed.

notes.title: v1.009 Patch - Immersion mode, new music, and bug fixes.
notes.content:
Immersion Mode: Pressing "T" or "D-pad down" will now toggle the HUD visibility. This includes boss health meters, the action button, and the red outline around targeted enemies, as well as... everything else. It can be toggled at any time during play, except during the tutorial.

New music: 4 new tracks have been added to the game and 1 track has been removed.


 Camp - Now has music in addition to the band's music.
 Mt. Tulderon - The old music has been removed by popular demand and replaced with music that we think suits the atmosphere of the game's beginning more appropriately.
 Histahnia Valley - the new songs from Mt. Tulderon will play after the Histahnia Valley song ends.
 Quardona Caverns and Ancient City of Eshalar - New songs have been added before the old songs and the volume of the old songs have been lowered to a more ambient level.
 The master mix has been adjusted somewhat to put more emphasis on the ambient nature sounds.


Additonal fixes and changes:


 A bug in Tul Alorea that sometimes forced players to reload has been fixed.
 A rare bug that could prevent the player from dying automatically when falling out of a level has been fixed.
 The clues in the Oasis have been adjusted very slightly to avoid a common misinterpretation.
 Certain puzzles have been made a bit more sturdy.
 A few locations have been improved visually.
 The different types of buttons and blocks now have subtle color coding.
 Several other minor adjustments

notes.title: v1.008 Patch - minor update
notes.content:
Various minor improvements based on player feedback.
 Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Launch Contest Update: We have our third and fourth winners!
notes.content:
Congratulations to our fourth winner, SilverSeraphym!

Congratulations to our third winner, Dicewolf!

Congratulations to our second winner, Sir Bittle!

Congratulations to our first winner, P_Taters!



Time is running out to join the winners circle!


How to participate:

The first five players to beat Goldenheart will get the alias of their choice put into books in the game, which will be placed in secret locations permanently. There is a short (4 questions) interview with them so that we can write a poem about their heroism for their book.

To win, you must be one of the first five people to post a screenshot of the ending cutscene. The screenshot must be posted on the Goldenheart steam community board, and the results will be judged by their timestamps.

Please also post a screenshot of your save-slot on the main menu to show us what difficulty you played on, how many health upgrades you found, and that it says 100% (in Goldenheart, 100% means you completed the story).


We're not going to make a rule about the difficulty setting, but we might factor it into your poem.
I wouldn't worry too much about being a late-comer as players are just beginning to trickle in - we'll continue to support the contest for as long as it takes.



Join our Discord to chat or report bugs.

notes.title: v1.007 patch - Emergency bug fix - Sorry!
notes.content:
We discovered that our patch v1.005 on December 1st introduced a pretty serious bug that caused many doors in the game to save as "Opened" whenever the level was reloaded after reaching a save point.

The bug has been fixed but if you are already part way through a level those doors could still be missing. You should be able to finish and the next level will be back to normal. 

If you got stuck in the maze in Nyvena because of this bug, the Red Door will unlock itself after 1.5 seconds.

Its possible that you have experienced this bug without noticing, and it's also possible that you played through without actually being affected by the bug because it is limited to certain areas and circumstances.

If your save data gets you stuck anywhere in the game, don't start over! Please let us know and we'll get it fixed as quickly as possible.

Thanks for your patience!!

notes.title: v1.006 patch - OpenDyslexic font is now used for dialogue boxes.
notes.content:
OpenDyslexic is a typeface designed against some common symptoms of dyslexia - It was recommended to us by a player. We found it to suit the game just fine and figured that a font designed to be easy to read will benefit everyone, so it has replaced the former YujiBoku as the font for the dialogue box in the game.
 We standardized the rest of the text to use only Overlock for system text and Averia Serif Libre for the Game Master text.
  The NPC instructions for what to do after exiting Kahlora Wash through the yellow door have been clarified.

notes.title: v1.004 patch - Bug fixes and another new save point.
notes.content:
A bug with the climbing walls, triggered by being attacked by the wasps while climbing, has been fixed and the wasp behavior has been adjusted.
 A bug that sometimes prevented the player from progressing after defeating a certain boss has been fixed.

notes.content:
The tutorial has been overhauled and the main menu now requires you to play through the tutorial one time before the start game button is enabled.
 The keyboard detection bug in the tutorial has been fixed
 A bug that sometimes broke a certain boss fight has been fixed
 More clues have been added to Histahnia Village pertaining to the location of the rope
 One new save point has been added to Quardona Caverns

 More patches coming ASAP, keep the bug reports coming please!
